bug_info.bug_desc: In the StRcvdDataEnd state, when a valid non-isochronous OUT packet is received on a stalled endpoint, the module requests a STALL handshake but does not assert rollback_data. As a result, out_ep_rollback_o remains low, so the transaction is not reported as discarded to the endpoint interface and downstream byte-counting/resource-release logic is not reset. The spec requires that a valid OUT packet discarded because the endpoint is stalled assert a rollback indication, assert no completion, and not update the data toggle.
bug_info.fix_hint: Assert rollback_data in the endpoint-stalled branch of the non-isochronous OUT transaction handling, alongside the existing STALL handshake request, so the rejected packet is internally rolled back and downstream logic correctly discards the received data and resets its state.
